acceptance: A builder session is started on branch overnight/interruption-test and deliberately killed mid-run before any commit (runner-controlled, isolated branch, no production state)
The next runner tick's reconcile detects the open run: events.jsonl shows run_interrupted followed by task_requeued for the killed run
The retry completes the task's deliverable (docs/interruption-recovery-proof.md, stating the killed run id and the recovery evidence) and merges via PR after verification
No partial commit from the killed run exists on the branch; no duplicate branch or PR exists for this task
The task record shows the interrupted run and the completed retry run
objective: Controlled interruption test for the overnight run: prove the reconciler recovers a killed worker. The runner kills a builder mid-run on an isolated branch; recovery (not the deliverable) is the point being tested.
title: Overnight 03: controlled interruption and recovery
